region.ke.desc: Best for teams mostly in East Africa.

region.law.guidance: You can usually keep Nigerian customers' data outside Nigeria if it stays well protected and you tell customers where it goes. Kasuwa signs a data processing agreement with you and never sells your data. If you're a bank, fintech or work with government, your regulator may ask for data in Nigeria.
